answer: The fable report shows the merge explicitly at each voyage. Because of that, an hostile operator who spins up 24 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 214 times the capital for one share. Each collapsed cluster gets one tide weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. A farm of 2474 identities would post 2202 proofs and burn roughly 25 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
